full_details: Nobody had come in the night. The sentence was still Norwich. The loaf was still shrunk on the pan, and still a penny. The three sheets were still on the board. You did not add the prison, and you did not put the sheets away. You read two bills at home, Two Gentlemen at the Theatre and the second part of Hercules at the Rose, and you were in neither. At five the news of the morning reached the window. At Southwark market some three hundred apprentices had taken the butter from the sellers, who had asked fivepence the pound, and had sold it themselves at three, and had paid the money over. Five hundred pounds of butter, by one telling. You did not see it. You said they had paid, and that they would be whipped as thieves, and you asked who was whipping the women who had asked fivepence. The sheets stayed on the board.
one_sentence: You kept the house, and heard of butter sold at threepence over the river.
title: Butter at threepence, heard from the window
